stage_name_zh: 阶段 3：逻辑写作、消融对比与六级/雅思托福高分论证（Day 51–75）
learning_objectives_zh: 通过 8 个核心词群（涵盖今日 27 个目标词条）掌握熟悉词汇的学术熟词生义（Polysemy）、一词多义边界、可数/及物性变化与自然搭配。
掌握句子成分精细分析（主、谓、宾、表、定、状、同位语）与核心语法：【G033】去除“AI 味（Anti-AI-ese）”与过度修辞：用具体机制、指标与实例替代空洞夸张；【G002】可数名词、不可数名词及多义词在不同义项下的可数性切换。
掌握学术表达模式：【EP005】描述系统模块、数据集或分类体系的构成，彻底消除头重脚轻、口语化、过度表达与空洞 AI 套话。
完成 36 道高密度、单点聚焦的实战练习，确保今日每个词条均获得至少 3 次训练（含至少 2 次主动输出）。

grammar_instruction.explanation_zh: 典型 AI 生成文本充斥着空洞的套话与浮夸副词/形容词（如 delve into, testament to, tapestry, underscores the paramount importance, revolutionize, unparalleled, groundbreaking），却缺乏具体技术细节。地道顶会论文（NeurIPS/ICLR/CoRL）与高分雅思/托福/六级写作追求“低修辞密度、高信息密度”：用具体动词、明确指标和真实实例说话。
rules: 删除无实质信息的“清嗓子”套话（Throat-clearing）：少用 *It is worth noting that / It is undeniable that / In the realm of modern artificial intelligence*，直接陈述事实主干。

禁止“只有夸张形容词而不给实例或数据支撑”：不要写 *The model achieves an enormous, unparalleled improvement*，而要写 *The proposed parametrization reduces MSE by 8.4% relative to the seasonal naive baseline on hourly electricity demand*。
优先选用朴素、精准的单音节或核心学术动词（examine, test, compare, constrain, decompose, bound, mitigate）替代故作高深的修辞词。
examples:
AI 腔/空洞夸张：*This groundbreaking paradigm delves into the intricate tapestry of temporal dynamics and achieves unparalleled accuracy.*
地道学术改写：*This model decomposes the series into trend and seasonal components, achieving lower forecasting error than the linear baseline on three benchmarks.*

六级/雅思空洞句：*Technology has an enormous impact on education in many ways.*
地道具体展开：*Asynchronous learning platforms allow part-time students to review lecture recordings at their own pace, reducing scheduling conflicts.*
common_errors: 堆砌 paramount, unprecedented, revolutionize, multifaceted 等宣传式词汇，违反客观学术语域。
只下宏大判断（如 *This method is very efficient*）而不给出具体的计算复杂度、内存占用或延迟数据。

grammar_instruction.name: 可数名词、不可数名词及多义词在不同义项下的可数性切换
grammar_instruction.explanation_zh: 不仅要区分绝对不可数名词（evidence, information, research, literature, equipment, apparatus, documentation, feedback, knowledge）与可数名词（study, finding, discrepancy, anomaly, covariate），更要掌握“同一单词在不同词义下的可数性切换”（Rule A.2）。
rules: 不可数学术名词不加 a/an 或复数 -s（严禁写 *an evidence, *researches, *equipments, *feedbacks）；表单项用 a piece/item of evidence, a research study, a piece of equipment。
一词多义下的可数性切换：discipline 表“纪律”不可数，表“学科”可数（two academic disciplines）；work 表“研究工作”不可数，workings 表“计算步骤”；experience 表“经验”不可数，表“经历”可数（experiences in childhood）；paper 表“纸”不可数，表“论文”可数。
量词精确匹配：修饰不可数用 a great deal of, a large amount of, much, less and less；修饰可数复数用 a large number of, a handful of, many, fewer and fewer。
examples: The transcription required a great deal of effort.
A large number of records still require checking.
The project draws on two academic disciplines.
All apparatus was checked before the experiment.
common_errors: 量词与可数性错配：*a great deal of participants / *an amount of respondents / *fewer time。
不可数名词误加复数：*many evidences / *new equipments / *useful feedbacks。

grammar_instruction.name: 语序、否定辖域、部分否定与句首否定倒装
grammar_instruction.explanation_zh: 精确控制否定与限定副词（only, solely, merely, by no means, under no circumstances, rarely, seldom）的辖域。当否定或唯一下界短语置于句首时，主句必须采用部分倒装。
rules: 区分全部否定（none of, in no way, under no circumstances, by no means）与部分否定（not all, not necessarily, not always）。
当 by no means, in no way, under no circumstances, in no circumstances, on no account, rarely, seldom, only when... 置于句首时，主句必须部分倒装（助动词/be/情态动词提至主语前）。
间接疑问从句（assess to what extent the results depend on...）一律保持陈述语序，不倒装。
examples: By no means is the result certain. (对比句中：A large sample is by no means sufficient to eliminate systematic bias.)
Under no circumstances should test labels be used for model tuning.
Only when the protocol was approved did recruitment begin.
common_errors: 句首否定强调漏掉倒装：*Under no circumstances test labels should be used。
间接疑问句误用倒装：*examine how does the system behave（应为 how the system behaves）。

expression_pattern_instruction.name: 描述系统模块、数据集或分类体系的构成
expression_pattern_instruction.template: [Whole System/Dataset] consists of / comprises [N] components, whereas [Subset] accounts for / constitutes [Proportion].
expression_pattern_instruction.explanation_zh: 用主动语态的 consist of / comprise 表整体由部分组成，用 constitute / account for 表部分占整体的比例。
examples: The questionnaire consists of three sections.
Missing responses account for a small proportion of the records.

expression_pattern_instruction.name: 使用 be of + 抽象名词结构自然提升评价语域
expression_pattern_instruction.explanation_zh: 自然替换口语化的 be very important/useful。
examples: The consent procedure is of particular significance to this study.
The evidence is of great relevance to the policy debate.
common_errors: *be of important（of 后必须接名词 importance）。

scheduled_review_words.polysemy_trap_zh: 词义与句法边界：常用 the advent of；advent 无对应动词。
scheduled_review_words.example_en: The advent of digital archives changed access to historical sources.

scheduled_review_words.polysemy_trap_zh: 形近词辨析：adverse（客观不利的，如具身智能在 adverse lighting/weather conditions 下测试）vs. averse（人主观反感的，be averse to risk）。
scheduled_review_words.example_en: The trial protocol specifies how adverse events will be recorded.

scheduled_review_words.polysemy_trap_zh: 词义与句法边界：也可作动词 aggregate observations。
scheduled_review_words.example_en: The aggregate of the three counts is sixty.

scheduled_review_words.polysemy_trap_zh: 词义与句法边界：water/energy conservation 指节约；wildlife conservation 指保护。
scheduled_review_words.example_en: Water conservation requires attention to both supply and demand.

scheduled_review_words.polysemy_trap_zh: 词义与句法边界：conserve 不等于 create；语境决定保护或节约义。
scheduled_review_words.example_en: The system reduces idle activity to conserve energy.

scheduled_review_words.polysemy_trap_zh: 词义与句法边界：能被明显注意到；不自动表示统计显著。
scheduled_review_words.example_en: The missing entry creates a conspicuous gap in the timeline.

scheduled_review_words.polysemy_trap_zh: 一词多义与跨语境迁移对比：[V00617 n.] 相关关系（例：A correlation between two variables does not establish causation.）；[V00618 n.] 相关关系；相关系数（例：A correlation between income and health does not by itself establish causation.）；[V00619 n.] 相关性（例：A correlation between measurements does not establish causality.）；[V00620 n.] 相关；标准化的统计关联（例：A correlation between two variables does not by itself establish a causal relationship.） | 本条用法约束：不能把统计关联直接写成 cause。
scheduled_review_words.example_en: A correlation between two variables does not establish causation.

scheduled_review_words.polysemy_trap_zh: 一词多义与跨语境迁移对比：[V00617 n.] 相关关系（例：A correlation between two variables does not establish causation.）；[V00618 n.] 相关关系；相关系数（例：A correlation between income and health does not by itself establish causation.）；[V00619 n.] 相关性（例：A correlation between measurements does not establish causality.）；[V00620 n.] 相关；标准化的统计关联（例：A correlation between two variables does not by itself establish a causal relationship.） | 本条用法约束：可能受混杂等影响；correlation coefficient 为量化指标。
scheduled_review_words.example_en: A correlation between income and health does not by itself establish causation.

scheduled_review_words.polysemy_trap_zh: 一词多义与跨语境迁移对比：[V00617 n.] 相关关系（例：A correlation between two variables does not establish causation.）；[V00618 n.] 相关关系；相关系数（例：A correlation between income and health does not by itself establish causation.）；[V00619 n.] 相关性（例：A correlation between measurements does not establish causality.）；[V00620 n.] 相关；标准化的统计关联（例：A correlation between two variables does not by itself establish a causal relationship.） | 本条用法约束：描述共变；与 causation 区分。
scheduled_review_words.example_en: A correlation between measurements does not establish causality.

scheduled_review_words.polysemy_trap_zh: 一词多义与跨语境迁移对比：[V00617 n.] 相关关系（例：A correlation between two variables does not establish causation.）；[V00618 n.] 相关关系；相关系数（例：A correlation between income and health does not by itself establish causation.）；[V00619 n.] 相关性（例：A correlation between measurements does not establish causality.）；[V00620 n.] 相关；标准化的统计关联（例：A correlation between two variables does not by itself establish a causal relationship.） | 本条用法约束：Pearson correlation 衡量线性关联；零相关通常不等于独立，相关系数也不能捕捉所有非线性关系。
scheduled_review_words.example_en: A correlation between two variables does not by itself establish a causal relationship.

scheduled_review_words.polysemy_trap_zh: 学术语境与搭配约束：词族 cramming；cram for，不用于所有密集学习的中性描述。
scheduled_review_words.example_en: The student tried to cram for the exam in one evening.

scheduled_review_words.polysemy_trap_zh: 词义与句法边界：cumulative distribution function 常简称 CDF；cumulative 不等于 average，累计效应还需明确时间和计量方式。
scheduled_review_words.example_en: A cumulative distribution function gives the probability that a random variable is no greater than a specified value.

scheduled_review_words.polysemy_trap_zh: 学术语境与搭配约束：deduce from；数学推导与经验猜测不同。
scheduled_review_words.example_en: We can deduce this bound from the stated assumptions.

scheduled_review_words.polysemy_trap_zh: 词义与句法边界：deduct A from B 即 B−A。
scheduled_review_words.example_en: We deduct the fee from the total payment.

scheduled_review_words.polysemy_trap_zh: 一词多义与跨语境迁移对比：[V00705 v.] 表示；指称（例：Here, N denotes the number of observations.）；[V00706 v.] 表示；标示（例：In the figure, a shaded band denotes the observation interval.） | 本条用法约束：常用于符号定义；主语可为符号。
scheduled_review_words.example_en: Here, N denotes the number of observations.

scheduled_review_words.polysemy_trap_zh: 一词多义与跨语境迁移对比：[V00705 v.] 表示；指称（例：Here, N denotes the number of observations.）；[V00706 v.] 表示；标示（例：In the figure, a shaded band denotes the observation interval.） | 本条用法约束：及物，符号或标记表示某项内容；不同于connote带有联想义。
scheduled_review_words.example_en: In the figure, a shaded band denotes the observation interval.
